N=len(TARGET)

# parse pairs
pairs={}
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(TARGET):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs[j]=i; pairs[i]=j

def fold(s):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(s)
    ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
    return ss,mfe

def bp_distance(s1,s2):
    # hamming on dot-bracket
    return sum(1 for a,b in zip(s1,s2) if a!=b)

def pair_set(ss):
    ps=set(); st=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(ss):
        if c=='(': st.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=st.pop(); ps.add((j,i))
    return ps

TARGET_PS=pair_set(TARGET)

def reward(ss):
    ps=pair_set(ss)
    # bp distance: target pairs missing + spurious
    missing=len(TARGET_PS-ps)
    spurious=len(ps-TARGET_PS)
    return missing+spurious

# build initial sequence
seq=list('A'*N)
comp={'A':'U','U':'A','G':'C','C':'G'}
# paired positions GC alternating
pair_list=sorted([(i,pairs[i]) for i in range(N) if i in pairs and i<pairs[i]])

        cur=[(i,j)]
if cur:stems.append(cur)
pats=["GCGC","CGCG","GUGC","CACG"]
for si,stem in enumerate(stems):
    pat=pats[si%4]
    for idx,(i,j) in enumerate(stem):
        a=pat[idx%4]; seq[i]=a; seq[j]=comp[a]
# loops
hp=[(22,26),(49,53),(71,76),(117,122),(145,149),(158,162),(195,200),(221,226),(284,290),(326,331),(343,347),(354,358)]
for i,j in hp:

N=len(TARGET)
pairs={}
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(TARGET):

def pair_set(ss):
    ps=set(); st=[]

            j=st.pop(); ps.add((j,i))
    return ps

def fold(s):

def reward(ss):
    ps=pair_set(ss)
    return len(TARGET_PS-ps)+len(ps-TARGET_PS)

# mismatched positions function: positions where ss differs in pairing state from target
def mismatch_positions(ss):
    ps=pair_set(ss)

    for (i,j) in TARGET_PS:

            bad.add(i); bad.add(j)
    for (i,j) in ps:
        if (i,j) not in TARGET_PS:
            bad.add(i); bad.add(j)
    return bad
